correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed published triangular equations (2.2),(2.5) and second-epidemic threshold (3.1) exactly. After cancelling ell^2*pi^2*(1-pi), the rational numerator has denominator (1+ell)^15(1+2ell)^10(1+3ell)^5 and Bernstein degree 13 in pi. All 406 rational coefficients in 14 nonzero ell-polynomial Bernstein rows are nonnegative, verified by exact algebra and inversion; hence strictly positive on ell>0 and 0<pi<1. An independently implemented CTMC finite-state calculation confirms all four final-size probabilities and outbreak means at ell=1, pi=1/2. At the defining unit threshold, strict monotonicity of the vaccination parameter gives hC<tilde hD; no claim for hD itself.

originality.rationale: The directly motivating 2023 source explicitly proves only n=2,3 (Theorem 4.11) and conjectures all sizes (Conjecture 4.12); the present n=4 Markovian all-finite-rate case closes a genuine nonperturbative missing case. Its small-local-rate and infinite-rate results do not imply all finite rates. Related vaccination and network articles concern different comparisons. The rigorous 406-coefficient rational sign certificate supplies new coverage; semantic-index searches revealed no equivalent or stronger public finding. Search incompleteness and potential unindexed equivalents remain residual risks.
residual_risks: The full 2016 historical vaccination preprint and 2023 network study were not exhaustively read; an unrecognized stronger inequality is possible, although their stated objectives differ.
Semantic search and publicly indexed literature cannot establish absolute priority, and unpublished or unindexed proofs may exist.

value.rationale: Conjecture 4.12 directly asks for n beyond 3 and all local-transmission rates. The first missing natural case n=4 with exponential infectious durations is nonperturbative and does not follow from previously published small-rate, infinite-rate or n2/n3 proofs. An exact positivity theorem explains all parameter values and rules out reversal under the Markovian assumptions; it is a motivated structural extension, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
